finding: All six failed F-AHL10 cases pass the frozen gates when K is restored to exact evaluation while derivative-consistent interpolated retention/capacity is retained. Restoring exact retention/capacity while retaining lookup K leaves the failures essentially unchanged.
important_secondary_finding: The analytical nonlinear iteration and backtracking path was preserved in all base and attribution variants; the problem is endpoint-response fidelity, not convergence-path stability.
design_implication: Retain the F-AHL09 derivative-consistent theta/C representation. Refine the shared support according to K error in the extreme regimes rather than abandoning the shared interpolant architecture.
next_action: Prospectively sweep tighter log(K) interpolation error while keeping the theta/C construction and all Richards gates fixed.
